notes.title: Construct VR moves to ImmersiX!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41069569/e79eb7b36a8c70b36bcfecba24193db9365338c8.png[/img]

[h1]Hi everyone! [/h1]

We want to notify you that, soon,  Construct VR will be available for free within ImmersiX, our new multi-content App showcasing the next generation of visual storytelling.  

For those of you who have bought Construct VR already, you will still be able to download the app from your library.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41069569/2f9a10b8332fb8c0eec8dc645c665acd2207ee2e.gif[/img]

We will be launching more free content via ImmersiX soon too - please wishlist us below to keep up to date on all upcoming releases! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1704450/ImmersiX/

Thank you!
-
V-Nova Studios

notes.title: Construct VR - Audio Update
notes.content:
We have just updated the PresenZ Player to improve the quality and stability of the audio.

If previously you were hearing frequent cracks in the sound or were experiencing desynchronization between the audio and the video, this update should resolve the issue.
Note that Oculus Quest+Link users may experience some audio glitches related to Link compression when their system is under heavy load. If that is the case, try lowering your headset resolution in the Oculus device settings.

This update will enable you to experience improved audio quality and more accurate spatialization in the upcoming Construct VR release.
